name: Single-leg calf raise
notes: One leg at a time, bodyweight or holding a dumbbell. Record reps per leg.

guide.setup: Place the ball of one foot on a stable step with the heel free, and rest a hand on a wall or rail for balance.
guide.execution: Lower the heel into a controlled stretch, then press through the ball of the foot to rise as high as possible.
guide.cues: Use a full range. Keep the knee softly straight. Pause at the top and bottom.
guide.mistakes: Pulling on the support to help; bouncing; bending the knee to cheat; rolling to the outer foot.
